  - heading "Less-Than Cumulative Frequency" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Less-Than Cumulative Frequency (CF) is the running total of frequencies up to and including each class.
  - paragraph: Drag any frequency to change it — all later cumulative totals, table, and graphs update instantly.

    - heading "2) LESS-THAN CUMULATIVE FREQUENCY (BAR VIEW)" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Stacked by class in order of upper class boundaries.
    - text: Show values
    - checkbox "Show values" [checked]
    - img "Cumulative frequency bar chart": 4 10 7 20 12 30 18 40 25 50 30 60
    - text: RECURRENCE (RUNNING TOTAL RULE)
    - strong: CFᵢ = CFᵢ₋₁ + fᵢ
    - text: with CF₀ = 0
    - heading "3) LESS-THAN OGIVE (STAIRCASE)" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Monotone staircase using upper class boundaries.
    - checkbox "Show points" [checked]
    - text: Show points
    - img "Less-than cumulative frequency ogive": 0 4 7 12 18 25 30
    - paragraph: Join the points (0, 0) and (xᵢ, CFᵢ) in order of upper class boundaries.
    - paragraph: This is the less-than ogive (cumulative frequency curve).
  - complementary:
    - img
    - strong: "IMPORTANT: Do NOT plot less-than cumulative frequencies against lower class boundaries."
    - paragraph: Use the upper class boundaries (xᵢ) on the x-axis for less-than ogive.

  - paragraph: 4 Observe the recurrence CFᵢ=CFᵢ₋₁+fᵢ.
